columns.comment: Credits charged against the pool. Always set: an unpriced call is charged a conservative fallback (config/plans.json), never zero.
columns.name: credits

columns.comment: Provider cost in USD, NULL when the provider/model has no price-table entry (a gap, not a free call -- same meaning as llm_call_log.cost_usd).
columns.name: cost_usd

Written by eo/usage_ledger.py (commit), called from utils/llm_client.py beside _record_call_log(), fail-open. "Used this period" is SUM(credits) over the period window, not a stored counter.…
tables.name: usage_ledger

columns.comment: Credits available per period for this account. Per-row rather than looked up from plan_key so a support top-up or grant can change one account without changing the plan definition.
columns.name: credit_pool

tables.comment: S01: one row per account -- plan_key (see config/plans.json), the size of its credit pool for the period, and the period window. Absent row = plans.json default plan, calendar-month window (eo/plans.py). Billing events and support adjustments write here; the app only reads it today.
tables.name: user_plans

checks: status not in ('approved', 'consumed') or user_id is not null
tables.comment: S03: in-flight device-code logins. Hashes of the device code and user code only (never the codes), the labels the terminal reported, and a status that moves pending -> approved -> consumed (or denied). Expires after about 10 minutes; purged a day later. Trusted-internal access only (eo/devices.py).
tables.name: device_pairings

columns.comment: SHA-256 hex of the device credential. The credential itself is shown to the device once, at pairing, and never stored.
columns.name: credential_hash

columns.comment: Last time the device exchanged its credential for a token (POST /v1/code/devices/token). Not a live-presence signal.
columns.name: last_seen_at

columns.comment: Set when the owner revokes the device. A revoked device can no longer get a token; NULL = active. Permanent: it cannot be cleared or changed. Rows are never deleted.
columns.name: revoked_at

tables.comment: S03: registry of paired M2C devices -- owner, name/OS/client version labels, SHA-256 of the device credential, last-seen and revoked timestamps. No content, no plaintext secrets, no foreign keys (eo/devices.py). Only last_seen_at and revoked_at can change.
tables.name: devices

columns.comment: Opaque run id minted by the client in run.start; the same string usage_ledger.run_id carries. Never parsed.
columns.name: id

columns.comment: A protocol/v1 error code (for example quota_exhausted), never a message.
columns.name: error_code

columns.comment: Informational running total. usage_ledger (migration 0012) is the metering truth.
columns.name: credits

tables.comment: S06: content-free metadata of an M2C run -- opaque id, owner, device, profile, mode, state, timestamps, a protocol error code and two counters. No title, prompt, text, path or message column: a run's content lives only in the encrypted Redis buffer (codeagent/buffer.py). Terminal states are final…
tables.name: runs

columns.name: issuer
